mechanism.name: binding-stack nudge at true depth, legalized by conflict-targeted re-placement under a clamp at the parent's own depth
mechanism.step1: select the k pieces with the largest TRUE transformed max-Y (the high_frontier_blockers ordering, general_relaxed.rs ~13165) and translate them d mm inward along the depth axis, creating a small, local, deliberate overlap
mechanism.step2: hand that state to persistent-vacancy mode 28 with the depth bound set to the parent's own depth, so every re-placed pose must fit a sheet clamped at the incumbent and nothing depth-ward of it can be published
mechanism.step3: mode 28 ejects the pieces incident to the induced clearance violations and re-places them through the construction insertion machinery under that clamp; publication is the authoritative validator's call against the real request
mechanism.whyItWasMissed: the pv34/pv35 drivers wrote reportedDepthMm/independentDepthMm = 200.0 into the perturbed fixture and passed 200.0 as the CLI target, so the harness installed a 200 mm incumbent (general_request_benchmark.rs ~316/378) and every separator contraction target derived from it (general_relaxed.rs ~2628). The measured '~179 shelf' was that fake 36 mm of headroom relaxing, not the layout. pv35 also ranked pieces by the translateLongAxis anchor, which on this layout ranges -25.2..+175.7 and has nothing to do with the depth frontier.
